title: 7 Dash Social Alternatives for Video-First Brands in 2026
summary: Dash Social hid its prices and still sells listening as an add-on. Compare 7 Dash Social (Dash Hudson) alternatives on video listening, pricing, and fit.
body_markdown:
**TL;DR:** The best Dash Social alternative depends on the job. Syncly Social is the strongest pick for video social listening, Sprout Social and Hootsuite for all-in-one management, Emplifi and Sprinklr for enterprise suites, Brandwatch for consumer research, and Later for budget scheduling. Teams usually start looking because Dash Social (formerly Dash Hudson) removed its public prices in September 2026 and sells social listening only as an add-on to its upper plans.


Dash Social earned its place in beauty and fashion. Rare Beauty, ColourPop, and florence by mills all appear on its industry page, and its Vision AI content predictions are a genuine strength (Source:[Dash Social, 2026](https://www.dashsocial.com/industry/beauty) ).


The friction starts when a team needs more than publishing. Listening is a paid add-on, and prices left the website in September 2026. For brands whose customers talk about products on TikTok and Reels, the bigger question is what a platform can hear and see inside a video.


**Dash Social** : the enterprise social media management platform formerly called Dash Hudson, renamed in January 2025, that combines publishing, analytics, Vision AI content prediction, UGC rights management, creator management, and an optional social listening add-on.


Here are seven alternatives, ordered by fit for video-first consumer brands.


## Why are brands looking for Dash Social alternatives in 2026?


Teams look for Dash Social alternatives for three reasons: pricing went private, listening costs extra, and reviewers flag limits in reporting and listening depth.


**1. Prices went dark.** Dash removed every price from its pricing page between September 14 and 21, 2026 (Source:[PricingSaaS, 2026](https://pricingsaas.com/companies/dashsocial/diffs/2026W39) ). The last public list was $999/month for Engage and $1,999/month for Advance. Our[Dash Social pricing breakdown](https://syncly.app/blog/dash-social-pricing) has the full history.


**2. Listening is an add-on on upper tiers.** Dash says social listening is "available to add-on to Dash Social's Advance and Enterprise plans" (Source:[Dash Social, 2026](https://www.dashsocial.com/features/social-listening-trends-and-topics) ). Engage customers have to upgrade before they can buy it.


**3. Reviewers flag gaps.** Dash holds a 4.7/5 rating from 410 G2 reviews (Source:[G2, 2026](https://www.g2.com/products/dash-social/reviews?qs=pros-and-cons) ). Among the criticisms, a social media manager at Honest Beauty wrote that reporting customization "can feel somewhat limited," and an enterprise reviewer said the listening "is a little behind or the sentiment is wrong."


For video-first brands, there is a structural question too. Dash's listening is built on topic, hashtag, and keyword monitoring, with a filter for visual similarity (Source:[Dash Social, 2026](https://www.dashsocial.com/features/social-listening-trends-and-topics) ). Its API documentation shows sample matches typed as caption mentions (Source:[Dash Social, 2026](https://developer.dashsocial.com/guides/social-listening/monitor-brand-mentions-with-social-listening-api.md) ). Dash does not document transcribing what creators say in videos or reading the text they put on screen.


Dash Hudson alternatives are the same list, since Dash Hudson became Dash Social in January 2025 (Source:[Adweek, 2025](https://www.adweek.com/commerce/dash-social-launches-creator-platform/) ).


## What are the best Dash Social alternatives?


The best Dash Social alternatives for 2026 are Syncly Social, Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Emplifi, Sprinklr, Brandwatch, and Later. Each one replaces a different part of what Dash does.


### 1. Syncly Social: Best for Video Social Listening


**Pricing:** Custom pricing | Free trial available
**Best for:** Beauty, F&B, and fashion brands where TikTok, Reels, and Shorts drive the conversation


[Syncly Social](https://syncly.app/social) is built for the video era. Its[video analysis](https://syncly.app/social/feature/video-analysis) combines Audio Intelligence, which transcribes what creators say, with AI Vision, which reads on-screen text and detects logos and products frame by frame. Together they power[untagged mention detection](https://syncly.app/social/feature/untagged-mentions) , catching your brand when a creator names or shows it without a tag, for 3–4x more data coverage than legacy, text-based listening.


LG Electronics used Syncly Social to analyze 970,000+ mentions across 10+ platforms, with 90% faster setup. Ask Syncly, the built-in AI agent, turns a plain-language question into a report with cited source videos.


**Where it wins:** Speech and on-screen text inside video, untagged mentions, listening as the core product
**Where Dash Social wins:** Publishing, UGC rights, and creator management in one suite


### 2. Sprout Social: Best All-in-One Management


**Pricing:** $79 to $399 per seat/month, billed annually (Source:[Sprout Social, 2026](https://sproutsocial.com/pricing/) )
**Best for:** Teams that need publishing, a care inbox, and X alongside light listening


Sprout is the most polished all-in-one option. Listening is an add-on for the Standard plan and up, its listening page does not document video or image analysis, and per-seat pricing scales fast. See our[Sprout Social alternatives](https://syncly.app/blog/sprout-social-alternatives) for more.


**Where it wins:** Public prices, X support, customer care workflows
**Where Dash Social wins:** Unlimited users, UGC rights, Vision AI content prediction


### 3. Hootsuite: Best for Listening Depth Inside a Management Suite


**Pricing:** $99 to $399 per user/month, billed annually; Enterprise custom (Source:[Hootsuite, 2026](https://www.hootsuite.com/plans) )
**Best for:** Larger teams that want scheduling plus enterprise-grade listening


Hootsuite agreed to buy Talkwalker in April 2024 (Source:[Hootsuite, 2024](https://www.hootsuite.com/newsroom/press-releases/hootsuite-agrees-to-acquire-talkwalker) ); the engine now runs as Lumen by Talkwalker. Hootsuite says it can "automatically detect brand mentions in images, video, and audio" across 150 million websites and 30+ social channels (Source:[Hootsuite, 2026](https://www.hootsuite.com/talkwalker) ). Basic listening comes with self-serve plans, but the advanced Lumen listening sits in Enterprise.


**Where it wins:** Documented image, video, and audio detection; channel breadth
**Where Dash Social wins:** UGC rights, Vision AI prediction, creator management


### 4. Emplifi: Best Enterprise Suite for UGC and Commerce


**Pricing:** From $1,249/month and $2,499/month (Source:[Emplifi, 2026](https://emplifi.io/pricing) )
**Best for:** Consumer brands that want social, care, ratings and reviews, and UGC in one contract


Emplifi overlaps most with Dash on UGC and commerce. Its visual listening uses "AI-powered image and video recognition to detect products and logos" even without a text mention (Source:[Emplifi, 2026](https://emplifi.io/resources/ai-and-social-listening-for-trends/) ). Listening is an add-on, and spoken-audio analysis is not documented.


**Where it wins:** Logo and product detection in images and video, reviews and care in the same suite
**Where Dash Social wins:** Creator management, ease of use (G2's most-cited praise for Dash)


### 5. Sprinklr: Best for Global Enterprise Standardization


**Pricing:** Quote-based only (Source:[Sprinklr, 2026](https://www.sprinklr.com/brand-factsheet/) )
**Best for:** Global enterprises running social, care, and insights on one platform


Sprinklr documents some of the deepest video analysis among the incumbents: "frame-level visual AI" that detects logos, products, and packaging, plus "voiceovers, sounds, and music trends decoded" (Source:[Sprinklr, 2026](https://www.sprinklr.com/products/consumer-intelligence/video-intelligence/) ). The trade-off is a large suite with enterprise contracts and a longer rollout.


**Where it wins:** Frame-level video and voiceover analysis, 30+ channels
**Where Dash Social wins:** Speed to value for a social team


### 6. Brandwatch: Best for Consumer Research Depth


**Pricing:** Custom; Vendr reports a median contract of $50,000 a year (Source:[Vendr, 2026](https://www.vendr.com/marketplace/brandwatch) )
**Best for:** Insights teams that need historical data and complex queries


Brandwatch covers more than 100 million online sources with data back to 2008, plus Image Analysis (Source:[Brandwatch, 2026](https://www.brandwatch.com/products/consumer-research/) ). It is a research platform first; publishing and UGC live in separate products. See our[Brandwatch alternatives](https://syncly.app/blog/brandwatch-alternatives-for) guide.


**Where it wins:** Source breadth, historical depth, query power
**Where Dash Social wins:** Publishing, UGC rights, and creator workflows for social teams


### 7. Later: Best Budget Option for Visual Scheduling


**Pricing:** $18.75 to $82.50/month, billed yearly, with a promotion shown on October 19, 2026 (Source:[Later, 2026](https://later.com/pricing/) )
**Best for:** Small beauty and fashion teams that mainly need Instagram and TikTok planning


Later is the lowest-cost way to replace Dash's scheduling and link in bio. Its listening features, including brand mentions and benchmarking for up to 20 competitors, are on the Scale plan only, and video or image analysis is not documented.


**Where it wins:** Transparent, low pricing; self-serve trial
**Where Dash Social wins:** Vision AI prediction, enterprise reporting, UGC rights at scale

"Not documented" means the vendor's own pages don't describe the capability, not that it is impossible. Ask for a live test on your own brand's videos before you sign.


That column matters because creators often say a product name out loud or hold the bottle up to the camera without typing it, and a caption-only platform records nothing. Our roundup of[video social listening tools](https://syncly.app/blog/top-video-social-listening-tools) explains how to test for it.


## Which Dash Hudson alternative fits a beauty or fashion brand?


Match the alternative to the job Dash was doing for you:


-


**What creators say and show about your brand:** Syncly Social


-


**Publishing, inbox, and light listening in one place:** Sprout Social or Hootsuite


-


**Social, care, reviews, and UGC under one enterprise contract:** Emplifi or Sprinklr


-


**Research-grade history and queries:** Brandwatch


-


**Affordable scheduling for a small team:** Later


Many beauty teams end up pairing two: a management suite for publishing and a listening platform for insight.


## Key Takeaways


-


Dash Hudson became Dash Social in January 2025, and Dash removed its public prices in September 2026.


-


Social listening on Dash is an add-on available only on the Advance and Enterprise plans.


-


Dash documents keyword, hashtag, and visual-similarity listening, but not transcription of what creators say in videos.


-


Syncly Social, Sprinklr, and Hootsuite's Enterprise-tier Lumen engine document audio analysis inside video.


Dash Social is still a strong pick for brands that want publishing, UGC rights, and creator management in one visual-first suite. If that is the job, staying may be the right call.


If your team is shopping because of the listening add-on, test what each platform hears and sees inside a video. In beauty and fashion, that is where the conversation about your products now happens.
